opnotes.name: Operation Note Generator
opnotes.description: Pick a procedure, fill in a few fields, and get a plain-text operation note to check and copy. Covers general surgery and trauma and orthopaedics.

scratchpad.name: Clinical Shift Scratchpad
scratchpad.description: A quick list for ward jobs during a shift. It stays on your device and clears itself when you’re done.
scratchpad.tagline: A ward-job list for one shift

aligned.name: AlignEd
aligned.description: Keeps your teaching plans, feedback and reflections together, then exports them for your portfolio.

casebook.name: Casebook
casebook.description: Turns your surgical logbook export into charts you can filter, and shows the exact entries behind every number.

parallax.name: Parallax
parallax.description: Practise reading X-rays: compare two views of the same wire, then see in 3D where it really lies.

glassbox.name: Glassbox
glassbox.description: Predict what happens, watch a recorded physiology experiment, then see what changed and why.

intro: I build small tools that run in your browser, for surgical training, ward work and teaching.
